_about: Timed events for the supermarket. A job plays 2 or 3 of them, the first at balance.events.firstAt seconds and then every balance.events.gap seconds. Actions: say (an announcement on the tannoy), signal (type, data, at = a spot name from the place's events or [x, z], points = several [x, z], range, repeat, every), spawn (thing, at = list of [x, z] or [x, y, z]). Nothing else happens on its own: grown-ups and things react to the signals.
